leviEnrich

Source: R/leviEnrich.R
leviEnrich.Rd

Run gene-set enrichment on the high-scoring (peaks) and low-scoring (valleys) regions returned by levi(). Uses clusterProfiler for GO and KEGG enrichment.

leviEnrich(
  result,
  top_n = 50L,
  bottom_n = 50L,
  organism = "hsa",
  orgdb = NULL,
  keytype = "SYMBOL",
  pval_cutoff = 0.05,
  types = c("GO_BP", "KEGG"),
  universe = NULL
)

Arguments

result

A single levi() result (list with $scores).

top_n

Integer. Number of top-ranked genes (by landscape score) to test as the "over-expressed" gene set. Default is 50.

bottom_n

Integer. Number of bottom-ranked genes to test as the "under-expressed" gene set. Default is 50.

organism

Character. KEGG organism code (e.g., "hsa" for human, "mmu" for mouse). Also used to select the OrgDb for GO enrichment: pass the OrgDb package name as orgdb. See clusterProfiler::enrichGO() for details.

orgdb

Character. OrgDb package name for GO enrichment (e.g., "org.Hs.eg.db" for human). If NULL, GO enrichment is skipped.

keytype

Character. Key type of the gene identifiers in result$scores$Gene (e.g., "SYMBOL", "ENTREZID"). Default is "SYMBOL".

pval_cutoff

Numeric. Adjusted p-value threshold. Default 0.05.

types

Character vector. Which analyses to run. Any subset of c("GO_BP","GO_MF","GO_CC","KEGG"). Default runs GO_BP and KEGG.

universe

Character vector. Background gene universe. If NULL (default), all genes in result$scores$Gene are used. For KEGG, both genes and universe are converted to ENTREZID using orgdb; with keytype = "ENTREZID", no conversion is needed.

Value

A named list with elements over and under, each a named list of enrichment result objects (one per requested type). Plots a dot-plot for each non-empty result automatically.

Details

Requires clusterProfiler (Bioconductor). Install with BiocManager::install("clusterProfiler"). For GO enrichment also install the relevant OrgDb, e.g. BiocManager::install("org.Hs.eg.db").

Examples

hub_n <- system.file("extdata", "hub_network.dat", package = "levi")
hub_e <- system.file("extdata", "hub_expression.dat", package = "levi")
res <- levi(expressionInput         = hub_e,
            networkCoordinatesInput = hub_n,
            fileTypeInput           = "dat",
            geneSymbolInput         = "ID",
            readExpColumn           = readExpColumn("Test-Control"),
            resolutionValueInput    = 10,
            smoothValueInput        = 5)

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Requires clusterProfiler and the org.Hs.eg.db annotation package,
# plus real gene symbols in the network.
enrich <- leviEnrich(res,
                     top_n    = 50,
                     orgdb    = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                     organism = "hsa",
                     keytype  = "SYMBOL")
enrich$over$GO_BP
enrich$under$KEGG
} # }
